q2_gaps: a possessive pronoun bound by a distributed coordinated subject ("Kroger ... and Albertsons ... locked out their union workers") -- the coordination rule says a shared object reuses one symbol, but says nothing about a possessum that co-varies with each conjunct; the parse split it into two disjoint worker groups
notes: "the next day" with no dated antecedent correctly falls back to the measured gap (BeforeBy sk_bargain_1 sk_lock_out_N 1 day), lock_out is kept whole as a particle verb, the possessed plural takes a group witness, and the present-tense "bargain" correctly gets no status atom. (Manner sk_bargain_1 jointly) is arguably redundant beside the collective multi-Agent encoding that "jointly" already selects, but the Manner-adverb rule licenses it.
